en.text: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.

footnotes.text: 6:1 The Hellenists used Greek language and culture, even though they were also of Hebrew descent.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，门徒增多，有说希腊话的犹太人向希伯来人发怨言，因为在天天的供给上忽略了他们的寡妇。

zhTraditional.text: 那時，門徒增多，有說希臘話的猶太人向希伯來人發怨言，因為在天天的供給上忽略了他們的寡婦。

en.text: The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, “It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables.

zhSimplified.text: 十二使徒叫众门徒来，对他们说：「我们撇下 神的道去管理饭食，原是不合宜的。

zhTraditional.text: 十二使徒叫眾門徒來，對他們說：「我們撇下上帝的道去管理飯食，原是不合宜的。

en.text: Therefore, select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

zhSimplified.text: 所以弟兄们，当从你们中间选出七个有好名声、被圣灵充满、智慧充足的人，我们就派他们管理这事。

zhTraditional.text: 所以弟兄們，當從你們中間選出七個有好名聲、被聖靈充滿、智慧充足的人，我們就派他們管理這事。

en.text: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.”

zhSimplified.text: 但我们要专心以祈祷、传道为事。」

zhTraditional.text: 但我們要專心以祈禱、傳道為事。」

en.text: These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch,

zhSimplified.text: 大众都喜悦这话，就拣选了司提反，乃是大有信心、圣灵充满的人，又拣选腓利、伯罗哥罗、尼迦挪、提门、巴米拿，并进犹太教的安提阿人尼哥拉，

zhTraditional.text: 大眾都喜悅這話，就揀選了司提反，乃是大有信心、聖靈充滿的人，又揀選腓利、伯羅哥羅、尼迦挪、提門、巴米拿，並進猶太教的安提阿人尼哥拉，

en.text: whom they set before the apostles. When they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

zhSimplified.text: 叫他们站在使徒面前。使徒祷告了，就按手在他们头上。

zhTraditional.text: 叫他們站在使徒面前。使徒禱告了，就按手在他們頭上。

en.text: The word of God increased and the number of the disciples greatly multiplied in Jerusalem. A great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

zhSimplified.text: 神的道兴旺起来；在耶路撒冷门徒数目加增的甚多，也有许多祭司信从了这道。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝的道興旺起來；在耶路撒冷門徒數目加增的甚多，也有許多祭司信從了這道。

en.text: Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.

zhSimplified.text: 司提反满得恩惠、能力，在民间行了大奇事和神迹。

zhTraditional.text: 司提反滿得恩惠、能力，在民間行了大奇事和神蹟。

en.text: But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.

zhSimplified.text: 当时有称利百地拿会堂的几个人，并有古利奈、亚历山大、基利家、亚细亚各处会堂的几个人，都起来和司提反辩论。

zhTraditional.text: 當時有稱利百地拿會堂的幾個人，並有古利奈、亞歷山大、基利家、亞細亞各處會堂的幾個人，都起來和司提反辯論。

en.text: They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.

zhSimplified.text: 司提反是以智慧和圣灵说话，众人敌挡不住，

zhTraditional.text: 司提反是以智慧和聖靈說話，眾人敵擋不住，

en.text: Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”

zhSimplified.text: 就买出人来说：「我们听见他说谤 摩西和 神的话。」

zhTraditional.text: 就買出人來說：「我們聽見他說謗讟摩西和上帝的話。」

en.text: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, then brought him in to the council,

zhSimplified.text: 他们又耸动了百姓、长老，并文士，就忽然来捉拿他，把他带到公会去，

zhTraditional.text: 他們又聳動了百姓、長老，並文士，就忽然來捉拿他，把他帶到公會去，

en.text: and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.

zhSimplified.text: 设下假见证，说：「这个人说话，不住地糟践圣所和律法。

zhTraditional.text: 設下假見證，說：「這個人說話，不住地糟踐聖所和律法。

en.text: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us.”

zhSimplified.text: 我们曾听见他说，这拿撒勒人耶稣要毁坏此地，也要改变摩西所交给我们的规条。」

zhTraditional.text: 我們曾聽見他說，這拿撒勒人耶穌要毀壞此地，也要改變摩西所交給我們的規條。」

en.text: All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.

zhSimplified.text: 在公会里坐着的人都定睛看他，见他的面貌，好像天使的面貌。

zhTraditional.text: 在公會裏坐着的人都定睛看他，見他的面貌，好像天使的面貌。
